long_biography.plain_text:
Jeremy Anwyl began his automotive career in 1979, advising dealers on consumer-centred and cost-efficient marketing. A decade later he founded Marketec Systems, whose consultancy work included retail studies and research for manufacturers such as Toyota and Lexus. He joined Edmunds.com at the turn of the century as chief operating officer, became president that year and was appointed chief executive in 2007. Under his leadership, the business expanded its digital pricing, ownership-cost and dealer-review tools.

After leaving Edmunds, Anwyl returned to consultancy, writing and mentoring start-ups. He founded AnwylPartners and later led Trucks.com, a trucking news and analysis platform. His public work has also included testimony to the United States Congress on fuel-economy standards and published commentary on automotive retailing, regulation and consumer behaviour.
